notes.title: Build up your own superhero organisation in the upcoming Superheroes Academy
notes.content:
Superheroes Academy is a new announcement from developer Strategy Forge, coming in 2022 your task is to build and run a school full of people with special abilities. Sound familiar? It's basically X-Men right?

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/11/build-up-your-own-superhero-organisation-in-the-upcoming-superheroes-academy
